records.source: Wow, it's loaded with treasure! This is sure to fetch a good price.
records.translation: Aba, punô ito ng kayamanan! Tiyak na mataas ang magiging presyo nito.

records.source: Fish don't escape while collecting treasures. Also slightly increases the chance to find treasures.
records.translation: Hindi nakatatakas ang isda habang nangongolekta ng kayamanan. Bahagya ring pinatataas ang tsansang makahanap ng kayamanan.

records.source: Use on diggable terrain to summon a ring of treasure spots.
records.translation: Gamitin sa lupang maaaring hukayin upang lumitaw ang paikot na mga puwesto ng kayamanan.

records.source: Sprinkle on a wild tree to ensure rapid growth, even in winter. Doesn't work on fruit trees.
records.translation: Ibudbod sa ligaw na puno upang matiyak ang mabilis na paglaki kahit sa taglamig. Hindi gumagana sa mga punong namumunga.

records.source: A long extinct relative of the crab.
records.translation: Matagal nang nalipol na kamag-anak ng alimango.
Masuwerteng Lilang Shorts na may Palamuti
records.englishResidueReason: Shorts is the conventional Filipino clothing loanword and preserves the recognizable quest-item name.

records.source: Purple silk shorts trimmed in luxurious gold...
records.translation: Lilang shorts na seda at may marangyang palamuting ginto...
records.englishResidueReason: Shorts is the conventional Filipino clothing loanword and preserves the recognizable quest-item name.
Shot and Espresso are conventional Filipino café loanwords for this drink.

records.source: It's more potent than regular coffee!
records.translation: Mas matapang ito kaysa karaniwang kape!

records.source: An exotic, fragrant curry served in a pineapple bowl.
records.translation: Kakaiba at mabangong karing inihahain sa mangkok na pinya.

records.source: Turn this in to the Trout Derby booth for a reward.
records.translation: Ibigay ito sa puwesto ng Derbi ng Trutsa upang makakuha ng gantimpala.

records.preserveReason: Truffle is the conventional Filipino culinary loanword for this specific fungus.

records.source: A gourmet type of mushroom with a unique taste.
records.translation: Pinong uri ng kabuteng may natatanging lasa.

records.englishResidueReason: Truffle is the conventional Filipino culinary loanword for this specific fungus.

records.source: The most popular spring flower. Has a very faint sweet smell.
records.translation: Ang pinakapopular na bulaklak sa tagsibol. Napakabanayad ng matamis nitong amoy.

records.source: Plant in spring. Takes 6 days to produce a colorful flower. Assorted colors.
records.translation: Itanim sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 6 na araw upang magpatubo ng makulay na bulaklak. Sari-sari ang kulay.

records.preserveReason: Tuna is the conventional Filipino fish name.

records.source: A large fish that lives in the ocean.
A broken branch. Chop with an axe to obtain wood.
records.translation: Nabaling sanga. Putulin gamit ang Palakol upang makakuha ng kahoy.

records.source: Rice in its rawest form. Run this through a mill to increase the value.
records.translation: Palay sa pinakahilaw na anyo nito. Iproseso sa Gilingan upang tumaas ang halaga.

records.source: Gain a little health every time you slay a monster.
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng kaunting kalusugan sa tuwing pumapatay ka ng halimaw.

records.source: An aged fermented liquid used in many cooking recipes.
records.translation: Pinaedad at binurong likidong ginagamit sa maraming resipe.
